close_flags.message: 拿住信封可以移动。右键翻面，滚轮放大；中键拖动画面。

scope: Actual routed viewport input with live GPU frames. Interruptions, rapid clicks and save recovery are checked. Wall frame timing belongs to this machine/offscreen process, not a promised player FPS. Native input and audio listening are separate.
